title: Chapter 841
text:
In the outer space of Planet Lighthouse, a giant dragon soared in the battlefield like a main ship. Its slender body was shrouded in colorful magic circles, blocking all the cannons and leaving behind a series of explosions.

Milizaus flapped his wings, his huge body rampaging. The magic energy in his body boiled, and he wantonly cast endless offensive spells, setting off a magic wave on the battlefield.

Beside Milizaus were two tiny figures. 'Light Beam' Sagman was surging with golden light energy, constantly shattering Milizaus' protective spells. The other 'Divine Spell' Ninjia was casting spells to fight Milizaus. The two of them kept him busy.

Due to his huge size, Milizaus' dodging ability was very poor, and he was practically a target. However, there were pros and cons. His tankiness could almost look down on all Mages, so his energy was extremely dense, and the power of his spells was also increased. Although Sagman and Ninjia could keep him busy, they were basically on par for the time being.

The three Beyond Grade As fought fiercely on the battlefield, and the surrounding fleets were constantly destroyed by the shockwaves.

"Two troublesome fellows …" Milizaus' dragon eyes were filled with solemnity. Sagman was the strongest of the six, and with the other Beyond Grade A Mage, it was very difficult to deal with them.

Although he could fight the two of them at the same time, he could not free himself to help Black Star.

"The goal of these two fellows is to keep me busy, but I can also keep the other two busy. However, there are still four people on Black Star's side. Even if I go over to help, those two will follow, and it's just as dangerous … Sigh, there's no other way. I hope Black Star and Beyoni can hold on. I can't help …"

Milizaus felt helpless. Even if he was extremely strong and was one of the three pillars of the dynasty, the two Beyond Grade As of the enemy were not to be underestimated. He had to focus on dealing with them and could not free himself.

If he hadn't gotten involved in this mess in the beginning, he wouldn't have gotten involved in this crisis …

The more Milizaus thought about it, the angrier he got, and the more he felt, the angrier he got. He raised his head and let out a mouthful of destructive dark golden dragon breath, which clashed with Sagman's light energy shockwave and exploded into dazzling fireworks.

"Heh, our four companions are fighting against two of you. Black Star won't be able to hold on for long. The battle over there will be over soon. Your resistance now is meaningless. Why don't you give up and join the Arcane Church? This is your only way out. You're not a direct descendant of the Empire, so there's no need to die for them."

At this moment, Ninjia used a spell to send a voice transmission to Milizaus. His cold words sounded in Milizaus' mind.

What answered him was an even more powerful dragon breath.

"Hmph, you really won't compromise." Ninjia's eyes turned cold as he casually released a huge magic shield to block the dragon's breath.

Sagman said calmly, "Then let's act according to the plan. He thinks that we are only going to stall him and create an opportunity to use the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter."

"Okay!"

At this moment, Milizaus did not know that not only Black Star, but he was also one of the Arcane Church's targets!

…

In the thin air of Planet Lighthouse, Han Xiao and Beyoni also started fighting with Sisko's group of four.

The moment the battle began, Han Xiao activated Reynold's Character Summon Card without hesitation. The Mechanical Force in his body seemed to have taken an aphrodisiac and swelled up.

Perfect Mechanical Sense!

This Character Summon Card could only be used three times. He had already used it twice before, so this would be the last time!

The 1.4 times increase in Machinery Affinity instantly raised the standard of his Mechanical Force to a whole new level. The densely packed Mech Legion around them immediately opened fire, and their attack power soared under the effect of Mechanical Force. The energy cannons formed a barrage that locked down the sky.

The four of them instantly moved. A blue light flashed in Dylan's eyes, and a huge amount of seawater gushed out from his body, forming water dragons that grew larger and larger. They circled around the four of them and formed a barrier. Under his control, the water curtain became extremely compressed, and it seemed to have become a solid shield.

Sisko did not stay idle either. He covered the water curtain with his psychic energy and formed multiple shields.

Boom! Boom!

Wave after wave of attacks landed on the water curtain and the psychic shield. The shields kept shattering, but they were constantly replenished by Psyker and Dylan, blocking most of the attacks. Working together, it was equivalent to the mechanical army needing to break through the defenses of two Beyond Grade As.

The four of them would not just stand there and wait to be attacked. They all moved at high speed.

'Desolate Beast' Mercer was a grayish-black humanoid more than seven meters tall. He looked like an upright beast with a thick mane growing from the top of his head to the bottom of his tail. His muscles were bulging, and he wore a simple special armor. He was wrapped in a powerful green Pugilist flame and charged toward them like a meteor.

Han Xiao had already activated his mechanical suit and covered his entire body. He had fought with Heber before, so he was very experienced in dealing with this. He constantly changed his position and controlled his mechanical army to intercept Mercer while maintaining a distance from him.

Facing four strong enemies, Beyoni did not dare slack off. He constantly activated his Esper Ability, and his main target was Dylan. He ignited a large amount of seawater and turned it into a sea of flames. The water curtain turned into clouds of white steam when it clashed with the sea of flames.

At this time, both Han Xiao and Beyoni felt a strange fluctuation in space. They both looked up and saw 'Sector Gate' Taylor holding his staff. His lips were moving as if he was chanting a spell. A huge magic formation appeared in the sky behind him, and the glowing patterns were as complicated as vines.

Boom!

The sound of the door of a palace being pushed open sounded in their ears. The next moment, the magic formation behind Taylor split open from the middle and turned into a huge circular door of light.

Inside the door of light was a pitch-black world. In the darkness, there were countless red light spots that looked like fireflies. They looked like the eyes of some kind of creature.

"This is … a summoning circle!" Han Xiao's eyes narrowed.

“rua！！！”

In the next second, countless strange bright red creatures roared as they surged out of the door of light. They were like a blood-red flood, and the scene was like a floodwater!

These creatures looked like mutated giant bats. They had sharp claws and bone spikes, horns on their heads, and two pairs of blood-red eyes on their faces that could shoot red lasers. Their appearance seemed to be related to demons.

After these summoned creatures appeared, they immediately found the mechanical army, and the two sides started fighting in midair.

Flesh and blood collided with machinery. Blood and engine oil flowed out. Pieces of flesh and broken parts fell like rain.

Taylor was a Mage, and he was best at summoning spells. This was where his nickname 'Sector Gate' came from.

"Summoning Mages are at a disadvantage for me …" Han Xiao clenched his teeth.

Army Style Mechanics and Summoning Mages were known as the two biggest hooligans, and they both used human wave tactics. The difference between the two was that Mechanics burned money and could build machines in advance, while Summoning Mages could only slowly summon their minions in battle, burning mana.

Now that Han Xiao's mechanical army had reached the scale of ten million, it would take a very long time for Taylor to summon minions of the same scale. At this time, the first batch of summoned creatures could not cause much damage to the mechanical army. However, if Taylor was not stopped from continuing to cast spells, more and more of his summoned creatures would be able to fight against the Mech Army sooner or later, greatly reducing the advantage of Han Xiao's human wave tactic.

If it was a one-on-one battle, Han Xiao had more than ten ways to interrupt the other party's summoning. However, this was a group battle, and it was two against four. He was pinned down by the enemy, and the difficulty of stopping Taylor from casting spells had increased exponentially.

"The Pugilist's sudden attack gives me pressure, and the Psychic and Control Esper are attacking while controlling the field, so the Summoner has no pressure. What a good combo."

Han Xiaoxin had a heavy headache. The enemy had clearly come prepared.

Beyoni also understood this point. The flames in his eyes burned brightly, and he also targeted his summoned creatures with his Esper Ability.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

His AOE ability was also outstanding, and his summoned creatures were ignited without any resistance, turning into falling meteors.

"I'll deal with him," Dylan said.

He controlled the seawater to surge toward Beyoni, and water tentacles reached out from the surging ocean to push away the mechanical army that was blocking his way.

He stepped on the waves, bounced his legs, and shot towards Beyoni like a cannonball, creating a whirlwind of fine splashes in the air.

The flames on Beyoni's body burned brightly, and his blood that once belonged to the Pyro Demon Race boiled. He opened his mouth and spat out red flames, instantly evaporating a large amount of seawater and clashing with the seawater that Dylan spat out in midair.

Fire and water, red and blue, neither side was willing to be outdone. Under the support of the powerful energy of both sides, they reached a stalemate and released a large amount of water vapor.

White mist quickly spread out, and vision was obstructed. However, this did not affect the Beyond Grade As.

Han Xiao did not have the time to care about anything else. The enemy only had one person to pin down Beyoni, while Sisko, Mercer, and Taylor surrounded him.

Facing the pressure of three Beyond Grade As at the same time, the damage to his mechanical army continued to rise. Fortunately, he had the bonus of Perfect Mechanical Sense, or he would have suffered even faster losses.

Han Xiao himself was in a very sorry state, constantly dodging the attacks of psychic, magic, and pugilist energy waves. He did not even have time to catch his breath.

With his current strength, facing three Beyond Grade As at the same time was beyond his ability. Beyond Grade As were all experts with rich combat experience, and their teamwork was very good. The combat strength they could unleash was not as simple as just adding together. Ninety percent of the time, he was dodging and defending, very passive.

While Sisko and the other two chased after Han Xiao, they also wantonly attacked the mechanical army. They had read the information and knew that Han Xiao had the title of 'Undying Black Star'.

Although they believed that Black Star would lose the title of 'Undying' if they worked together, only by getting rid of the mechanical army would they have a safe environment to attack. After all, the Mech Legion was indeed very threatening. With the bonus of Perfect Mechanical Sense and the True Damage of [Legendary Battle Technique], if they were careless, they could be heavily injured by Black Star at any time.

Therefore, Sisko and the other two focused on taking care of Han Xiao's mechanical army.

The mechanical soldiers were destroyed by the attacks of the Beyond Grade As one after another, but they were pulled back by Han Xiao's [Waste Modification]. It was like a tug of war.

"If this continues, it'll be bad …" Han Xiao complained while dodging the attacks.

Although he could repair the Mech Legion, there was a limit to the number of times he could repair it. There were four Beyond Grade As on the other side, his mechanical army would definitely not be able to outlast them.

If all his mechanical army was destroyed, he would become a toothless tiger. No matter how tanky he was, he would not be able to fight back.

…

Planet Lighthouse and the Arcane Church's fleet started an all-out war. The sky and the ground were both filled with battlefields.

Milizaus' Armed Dragon Guards had already joined the battle. The heavily-armored giant dragons fought with the battleships, tearing apart each other's armor and dragon scales.

Hella, Hardaway, Fu Ding, and the rest of the Black Star Corps Black Star Guards also joined the battle outside the atmosphere, helping the dynasty's fleet fight against the Arcane Church's battleships.

The Calamity Grade officers shuttled through the battleship formation one after another, using their abilities to destroy the enemy's battleships.

Although they wanted to help Han Xiao, they knew their limits. The battle between six Beyond Grade As was not something they could interfere with. They would only be cannon fodder if they went. The only thing they could do was fight alongside the dynasty's fleet.

The Black Star Guards were all elite Calamity Grades, so they could shine on the battlefield.

Other than sending out Beyond Grade As, the Arcane Church also sent out a group of Calamity Grades. However, their numbers were not as great as the dynasty's.

The Calamity Grades of both sides quickly found each other and started fighting.

Hadavy endured a sea of attacks and slashed at the Calamity Grade Supers that he caught.

Fu Ding controlled his psychic power and moved gracefully between the crisscrossing energy beams. His psychic power accurately hit his target time and time again.

Hella was even more powerful. In such a huge battlefield, she was constantly provided with souls, increasing her strength rapidly.

Without holding back at all, the dark red death energy gushed out like a tsunami. It was completely overwhelming, and it did not take long for Hila to kill her opponent and absorb his soul.

She took the opportunity to look at the battlefield in the sky above Planet Lighthouse. The six of them, including Han Xiao, were fighting there. The shockwaves they released were too terrifying, and it had already become a forbidden zone.

"… Don't die."

Hella bit her lips and decisively turned around to look for the next enemy.

…

The battlefield in the sky was constantly moving, and the summoned creatures grew larger and larger. On the contrary, the number of mechanical soldiers was decreasing.

The two of them became more and more passive.

Han Xiao also received quite a number of attacks, but his recovery ability was strong, so he was not affected much.

However, Beyoni was different. He did not have a very strong physique, and he had almost no means of defending against Sisko's psychic attacks. He could only barely hold on, and the situation was getting worse and worse.

"This guy can't hold on much longer …" Looking at Beyoni, who was covered in wounds, Han Xiao's heart sank.

This teammate was his only support at the moment. If he was killed, he would have to face four Beyond Grade As alone. By then, he might not even have the chance to deal with them.

At this time, Sisko's group of four exchanged glances and suddenly launched an even more intense attack on Han Xiao.

Xiu!

A white jade beast statue that was a few hundred meters tall spat out a gray beam of light toward Han Xiao. It was an elite summoned creature under Taylor's command.

Han Xiao hurriedly turned around and dodged. The fact that he had the Void Bloodline had long been recorded in his information. His Void Hyperdrive was targeted by the enemy.

As a Beyond Grade A Mage, Taylor was naturally proficient in controlling multi-dimensional energy. This was the basic skill of a Summoner to communicate with their summoned creatures. As long as Han Xiao entered the Void Hyperdrive, he would be forced out by the enemy's spells. He would not be able to maintain the Void Hyperdrive state for long, so he would not be able to escape.

In fact, when the Arcane Church fleet appeared, the Void Hyperdrive could no longer help Han Xiao escape. Even if he abandoned everyone and escaped by himself, the hyperdrive speed of the Arcane Church spaceship would not be slower than him. They would catch up to him very quickly, and he would be alone.

After dodging the beam, the psychic power and water dragon swept toward him. Han Xiao opened his psionic shield and dodged while defending.

At this time, a figure appeared in front of him as if teleporting. It was Mercer, and his fists smashed down.

"Is this the teleportation technique Heber used before?" Han Xiao was shocked and hurriedly made a defensive stance.

However, the next moment, the fist that landed was like an illusion, passing through Han Xiao's body. It did not feel real at all, proving that the person in front of him was an illusion.

"Sh * t!" Han Xiao immediately reacted. His expression changed, and he hurriedly looked toward Beyoni's direction.

As expected, Taylor used a spell, and the real Mercer turned around and approached Beyoni while using his aura concealment spell. Under Beyoni's panicked expression, shadows of his fists filled the sky.

Dong dong dong!

Beyoni was hit repeatedly, and his injuries quickly worsened. The other three immediately changed their target and attacked Beyoni at the same time as if they had planned this beforehand!

If he was hit by the combined attacks of four Beyond Grade As, with Beyoni's current injuries, he would most likely enter a state of near death.

Whoosh!

At this critical moment, Han Xiao could not care less. He used his restricted Void Hyperdrive and appeared right in front of Beyoni in a hurry. This distance was still doable.

Then, Han Xiao directly pushed Beyoni behind him and faced the combined attacks of the four Beyond Grade As.

Boom!

His mechanical suit shattered, and a large chunk of his health instantly disappeared!

Han Xiao's vision blurred, and his entire body was in intense pain. He was sent flying like a baseball, spinning in the air.

The mechanical army hurriedly blocked the pursuit of Sisko's group of four without caring about the casualties. Only then did he have time to stabilize his body.

Enduring the intense pain from his wounds, he looked at his plummeting health.

"This damage is too terrifying. If I hadn't stopped it in time, Beyoni would have died …"

Han Xiaoxin bitterly smiled. This time, he had really become a meat shield for Beyoni.

Beyoni hurriedly retreated to Han Xiao's side, supported his body, and said with a hoarse voice, "Are you okay?"

"I'm okay. I won't die so easily. Don't forget what my nickname is."

Han Xiao shook off his hand, took a deep breath, and activated his cell regeneration ability, allowing his terrifying injuries to gradually recover.

"Thank you. If not for you, I would have died …" Beyoni's tone was filled with gratitude, but it then became sorrowful. "No, we're still going to die. It's just a matter of time."

"Aren't you talking nonsense? Anyone will die." Han Xiao could not help but glance at him.

"…"

Beyoni choked and had a helpless expression. You're still in the mood to joke at a time like this?

However, Han Xiao then shook his head and said with a firm tone.

"However, today is not the day of our death!"

Just as the four Beyond Grade As, including Sisko, were planning to follow up with another attack, Taylor suddenly paused and said with uncertainty, "Wait, wait.

"Wait, I sense a strange magical fluctuation approaching through the secondary dimension … So powerful!"

At this time, the space not far away suddenly twisted, and an expanding teleportation gate appeared.

At this time, the dynasty's anti-wormhole device had already been shut down. Taylor wanted to use space magic to counter this teleportation gate that suddenly appeared, but he realized that the magic wave of this teleportation gate was far stronger than any Mage he had ever seen!

Taylor was shocked. With his ability, he was unable to stop the teleportation gate from forming?

The next moment, an enormous castle wrapped in dense magic light jumped out of the teleportation gate.

"Why is he here?!"

Sisko's eyes widened. As a Beyond Grade A in the Shattered Star Ring, he was all too familiar with this thing.

It was the Palace of Hidden Spells!

Austin floated at the top of the castle of the Palace of Hidden Spells. Behind him were countless red-robed Forbidden Sorcerers, all looking at them.

He adjusted his loose robe, and an inexplicable smile appeared on his face.

"Ah, I'm not late, am I?"

It's a little late today, and this chapter has quite a lot of words, so it took me a while to write.
